{{Top}}
An '''alarm system''' was a system of alarms placed aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]], as well as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] shot [[Shann Childsen/Legends|Shann Childsen]] to keep him from activating the the alarm system installed on the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].

Networks of [[Sensor beacon/Legends|sensor beacons]] were set up as a type of alarm system.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Remote installations, such as [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], were protected by alarm [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] working in conjunction with security lighting and [[Power fence/Legends|power fences]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=2X-3KPR (Tooex)}}</ref>
